events.title: Hextracer is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hextracer is in Steam Next Fest! From October 19 to 26, you can play the free Hextracer demo as part of Steam Next Fest. Find the goal in hex mazes that reveal themselves as the clock ticks. Move now, or wait for a clearer path? What's in the demo Solo runs of up to 36 levels, with open, island, and walled mazes Quick challenges between mazes Optional Modifiers that bend the rules Online races for up to six players with Quick Match, room codes, or Steam invites Demo races are open until Next Fes

events.title: Hextracer 0.11.1 - Five new achievements
events.summary: Five new Steam achievements are here: survive a long run without a single reset, clear every kind of challenge, and win races in a full lobby, by a hair, or without slipping up once. VOID also stops hiding the Modifier pickups on the tiles you can step to next. Added Five new Steam achievements to chase: finish a long run without a single reset, clear every kind of challenge, win a full six-player race, win by a hair, and win a race without a single reset. Fixed VOID no longer hides Modifier pic

events.title: Hextracer 0.11.0 - Music that moves with you
events.summary: The music now plays along with you: the drums follow your moves, react to walls and pauses, and the songs flow into each other right on the beat. Modifiers show up less often but land where they matter more, challenges ramp up gradually across the whole run, and the main menu has new links to share feedback, join the Discord, and catch up on what's new. Added Added Feedback, Discord, and Release Notes buttons to the main menu, so it's easy to tell us what you think, hang out with other players,

events.title: Hextracer 0.10.0 - Islands, ghosts, and three new challenges
events.summary: Open Grid and Walled Grid are now one mode, and every run mixes open ground, walled mazes, and new Archipelago islands as you go. Three new challenges join the lineup, replaying a seed lets you chase a ghost of your best run, and the music now reacts as you play. Added Added Archipelago levels: small walled islands linked by open paths. Added three new challenges: slide to a stop in Slipstream, outrun hunters in Countertrace, and push packets into place in Packet Switch. Added a PB ghost. Replay

events.title: Hextracer 0.9.1 - Clearer menus and run history
events.summary: Menus are easier to navigate, and each color theme now shows its palette at a glance. There may be octagons now. We don't talk about those. History separates Solo and Race, remembers your Solo Modifier filter, and puts run details into a quick-to-scan summary. The end-of-run screen leads with your time, and the in-game color preview now fills its frame cleanly. Changed - Cleaned up the menus with clearer actions and more room for color settings. - Theme choices now show all five colors at a glan

events.title: Hextracer 0.9.0 - Make the maze your own
events.summary: Start with a built-in color theme, then tweak each color to make it your own. Regular tiles now have their own color setting, and the live preview shows how your choices will look in the maze. Walled Grid's lower walls make the tiles easier to see, and Hextracer has a fresh new look. Restore Helper Dialogs brings back instructions you've hidden. Demo sliders now show the full range and explain the 36-level limit only when you try to go beyond it. Added Added color themes inspired by Tokyo Night,

events.title: Hextracer 0.8.0 - Calmer motion and clearer challenges
events.summary: Reduce Motion now softens shakes, glitches, transitions, ambient movement, pulses, and rapid flashing without changing gameplay timing or hiding important feedback. Tracefield routes are easier to follow, and mistakes across minigames now use the same clear feedback as maze resets. This update also fixes off-route movement in Tracefield and Ghost Path. events.title: The Hextracer Demo Is Live!
events.summary: The maze is open! The Hextracer Demo is live! I'm thrilled to finally share it with you on Windows and Linux. Jump in right now, start tracing, and see how fast you can find your way through the dark. Hextracer is about racing through a maze you can only see a little at a time. Trust your instincts and move now, or wait for more of the route to appear while the clock keeps running. Then replay the same seed, spot the route you missed, and take another shot at a faster time.
